description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PDFWrapper component within the SuiteCRM project. It tests the methods of PDFWrapper such as getting available engines, the default engine, and adding a new engine. The file includes class definitions, unit test methods, and references external classes and namespaces.

classes.name: PDFWrapperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the PDFWrapper, extending the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase, testing PDFWrapper static methods.

methods.name: testGetEngines
methods.description: Tests that PDFWrapper::getEngines returns the expected array of engine names.

methods.name: testAddEngine
methods.description: Tests adding a new engine to PDFWrapper and verifies it is included in the list of engines.
